text:
Type: faux fur throw blanket
Use: warmth and layering on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, classic
Materials: plush faux fur with ribbed texture, soft reverse
Colors: ivory, warm cream
Shape: large rectangular throw, raised channeled stripes in a block pattern, deep pile, finished edges, generous and soft drape
Feel: cozy, luxurious, soft, warm
Goes with: beige, taupe and blush upholstery, light wood, neutral walls; glam, classic or contemporary rooms

product.name: Pinzon Faux Fur Throw Blanket 63" x 87", Ivory
product.description: Faux fur throw for sumptuous softness and a luxurious layer of cozy warmth About 1/2-inch thick on one side and velvety soft fabric on the reverse Made of 100% polyester; faux fur, so it’s animal friendly (no animals harmed) Ivory color for neutral, yet sophisticated beauty; measures 63 by 87 inches Made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards.
